standard-dialogue.npc: Hello. Are you here for my black dragons?

options.text: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
options.condition: If the player has black dragons as a slayer task:

steps.player: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.

steps.npc: Fair enough. Do what you have to do.

options.condition: If the player does not have black dragons as a slayer task:

steps.npc: Oh, good. In that case you're welcome to go and admire them, but don't get any ideas about killing them.

options.text: Why are you here asking about that?

steps.player: Why are you here asking about that?

steps.npc: Because I like my black dragons, and I had to work hard to get access to their lair, and I don't want people using them for training without a reason.
So if one of the Slayer Masters sent you to slay black dragons, that's fine, but otherwise you should go and train elsewhere.
I'd rather people didn't train on my dragons at all, but I've got a distant cousin who's a Slayer Master, so I've got to support the family business.

options.text: Excuse me, I've got to go.

steps.player: Excuse me, I've got to go.

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: Hey, go and train somewhere else! I'm not having people mess with my dragons unless a Slayer Master's told them to do it.
